step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identified core system components from visual input and transcript: Data Scientist actor, Amazon ECR container registry, S3 DATASET bucket, S3 MODEL bucket, Amazon SageMaker components (Notebook, Train, Model, Endpoint), AWS Lambda, and Amazon EC2.
2. Analyzed training workflow (Flow 0): Data Scientist pushes custom container images to ECR and uses SageMaker Notebook to trigger training jobs. Training process pulls images from ECR and datasets from S3 DATASET to output trained model artifacts.
3. Analyzed inference/serving workflow (Flow 1): SageMaker Endpoint loads container from ECR and model artifact from S3 MODEL. EC2 production workload calls Lambda function, which invokes SageMaker Endpoint for real-time model predictions and returns enriched response to EC2.

graph.name: Content Wise Machine Learning Platform on SageMaker
graph.categories: Machine Learning, Analytics & Data Processing, Compute & Serverless
graph.notes: Architecture used by Content Wise to build, train, and deploy custom machine learning algorithms for digital content personalization using Amazon SageMaker, AWS Lambda, and Amazon EC2.

nodes.name: Data Scientist
nodes.notes: Coordinates model prototyping, experiment runs, and pushes custom container images.

nodes.name: ECR
nodes.notes: Stores custom Docker container images extended via SageMaker container libraries.

nodes.name: S3 DATASET
nodes.notes: Stores raw and preprocessed datasets used for SageMaker training.

nodes.name: NOTEBOOK
nodes.notes: SageMaker Notebook instance used by data scientists for analysis and triggering training runs.

nodes.name: SAGEMAKER
nodes.notes: SageMaker service managing training execution and hyperparameter tuning.

nodes.name: S3 MODEL
nodes.notes: Stores trained model artifacts generated from training jobs.

nodes.name: ENDPOINT
nodes.notes: Hosted SageMaker endpoint serving real-time model inference.

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Serverless compute function that invokes SageMaker Endpoint and enriches response payload.

nodes.name: EC2
nodes.notes: Hosts production application infrastructure initiating real-time prediction requests.

edges.notes: Data Scientist pushes custom Docker images to ECR.
